title: CODATA 2022: the neutron mass-energy is 1.505 349 765 14 × 10⁻¹⁰ J
summary: The standard uncertainty is 0.000 000 000 76 × 10⁻¹⁰ J. It is slightly above the proton's joule line in the same listing.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'neutron mass energy equivalent 1.505 349 765 14 e-10' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 76 e-10', unit J. Set next to the proton's joule line in the same listing, the neutron's figure is larger. That is the table. It is not a decay calculation.

sources.title: Fundamental Physical Constants, complete listing, 2022 CODATA adjustment
sources.author: NIST, CODATA 2022 recommended values
sources.note: Complete listing opened 2026-11-18. Digits are from lines printed in full.
